title: Digital Marketing Agency in Saudi Arabia

seo.title: Digital Marketing Agency in Saudi Arabia — Web, Ads & AI
seo.description: Keelbiz helps businesses in Saudi Arabia grow with websites, social media, Meta & Google Ads, AI agents and dashboards. One service or a complete solution.

blocks.title: Digital marketing and AI automation for businesses in
blocks.lead: Arabic-first websites, social media, Meta & Google Ads, AI agents and business dashboards for companies in Saudi Arabia — taken one at a time or combined into a complete solution.

items.title: Arabic first, not Arabic as an afterthought
items.text: Copy, layout and creative are prepared in Arabic from the start, with English alongside where your audience needs it.

items.title: A mobile, social-first audience
items.text: Customers in the Kingdom spend much of their time on phones and social apps, so pages load fast on mobile and campaigns are designed for the feed.

items.title: Timed for Ramadan and the national seasons
items.text: Campaign plans are built around Ramadan, Eid, National Day and Founding Day, with content prepared well ahead of each one.

blocks.title: Five services. Take one, or
blocks.lead: Every service is available on its own, with a custom quote. No forced bundles.

items.q: Do you work with businesses anywhere in Saudi Arabia?
items.a: Yes. Keelbiz works remotely with businesses in Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam and across the Kingdom, by video call, email and WhatsApp.

items.q: Is your Arabic content written by hand or translated automatically?
items.a: Arabic pages and campaign copy are written and reviewed as Arabic content, with proper right-to-left layout. We do not publish raw machine translation.

items.q: Can an AI agent reply to my customers in Arabic?
items.a: Yes. AI agents can be set up to answer common questions, qualify enquiries and book calls in Arabic and English, with a handover to your team when a person is needed.
Every project gets a custom quote after a short discovery call. Third-party costs such as ad spend, domains or software subscriptions are paid by you directly and are always shown separately.
